disclaimer: Technical record of this build's data flows for a firm's POPIA documentation. It is not legal advice and does not replace the firm's own records or its counsel's review.

dataCategories.description: Firm name and slug, user names and email addresses, roles, and API-key name, prefix and SHA-256 hash. The API key itself is never stored.
dataCategories.retention: Until the firm or user is deleted through an operator process; there is no self-service deletion yet.

dataCategories.description: Activity events: source system and source id, actor, kind, start and end times, capture time, subject title, participant domains and addresses, and privacy flags.
dataCategories.retention: Immutable; no automatic deletion is configured in this build.

dataCategories.description: Hand-recorded calls, meetings and notes. Only the title the person typed is kept; no note body or transcript.
dataCategories.retention: Immutable; no automatic deletion is configured in this build.

dataCategories.description: Excluded domains, client or matter identifiers, an optional reason, and the creator and creation time.
dataCategories.retention: Until an administrator removes the exclusion.

dataCategories.description: An opaque cursor per connector and firm, so a connector resumes where it stopped.
Sealed provider credentials (AES-256-GCM ciphertext and a wrapped data key), the label, the last four characters, allowed hosts and audit metadata. Values are never shown after they are stored.
dataCategories.retention: Until revoked; revoking destroys the ciphertext and keeps metadata only.

dataCategories.description: Hash-chained audit entries for secret actions, and outbox envelopes such as activity.recorded. No credential or content value is included.
dataCategories.retention: Append-only; no deletion is granted to the services.

dataCategories.description: Captured message bodies, documents or transcripts, referenced by contentRef. Off by default: content is accepted only after redaction.
dataCategories.storage: No content store is wired in this build.
dataCategories.retention: Not applicable until content capture is enabled.

flows.data: Manual entry: kind, start and end times, title; the API key in the Authorization header

flows.from: A connector or service holding a tenant API key
flows.data: Activity event metadata and its canonical id
The presented API key, checked on every request; the key is not forwarded
Provider credential on write; metadata only on read. Values are never returned.
Domain, client or matter exclusion and an optional reason

flows.to: The service log (a broker is not deployed yet)
flows.data: Activity event envelopes without content or credentials
Prompts derived from activity metadata or redacted content
flows.storage: No model calls are routed in this build.

processors.name: PostgreSQL
processors.purpose: Primary store for identity, capture, vault and outbox data
processors.region: The deployment region (self-hosted: the firm's own infrastructure)

processors.name: SeaweedFS
processors.purpose: S3-compatible object storage in the development stack

processors.name: Anthropic
processors.purpose: Model inference when a firm configures a key
processors.region: Global or United States; no African inference region is offered

retentionNote: No automatic retention or deletion policy is configured in this build. A firm's retention rules are a deployment and Phase 4 concern; this register will state them here when they exist.
